svg.title: Compare shifts on the same time axis
svg.desc: Three vertically stacked rows show an original decaying sine wave, a copy shifted by about half a period, and a copy shifted by about one period. Vertical guides through the original peaks reveal poor alignment in A and close alignment in B. The mismatch curve below shows the corresponding scores.
svg.text: Slide the same decaying wave, then compare its alignment
All three rows use the same horizontal scale and amplitude scale.
Guides mark the original peaks. A misses them; B lines up but has lower amplitude.
Synthetic sine wave with exaggerated decay. The mismatch curve is computed from the same signal.
